title: Outer Banks Center for Wildlife Education

services.name: Wildlife tour
services.desc: All classes meet in the lobby of the Outer Banks Center for Wildlife Education unless otherwise noted. We will call registered program participants to let you know about any weather cancellations. Note: This class meets at the public beach access (E. Corolla Village Rd.) across from the lighthouse. Meet instructor by the green sign near the boardwalk. Join us for a guided beach walk! Shells, shore birds, sand, or dolphins, we’ll talk about whatever we find along the way.
